guarantees.claim: tlram_rvalid is asynchronously cleared to 0 when rst_ni is low.
When rst_ni is high, tlram_rvalid updates on every posedge clk_i to (tlram_req & !tlram_we).

assumptions.claim: tlram_req and tlram_we are synchronous to clk_i and originate from registered logic in the same clock domain.
assumptions.cond: always, because tlram_rvalid samples them directly on the clock edge
assumptions.risk: If inputs are asynchronous, tlram_rvalid may experience metastability or incorrect sampling, leading to spurious read valid assertions.

uncertain_points.claim: The functional role of tlram_rvalid (read valid vs read enable) is not inferrable from this block alone and depends on the TL-RAM interface protocol.
uncertain_points.cond: whenever tlram_rvalid is used by other modules
uncertain_points.risk: Misinterpretation could lead to incorrect read completion handshake or false read cycles at the system level.
